prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high-fidelity, production-plausible desktop web-app screenshot of LecNote, 1536x1024 landscape. No device frame, no browser chrome, no collage, no marketing hero. This is a real operational lecture-study app, not a landing page. The screenshot must show a populated demo library using only these sample facts: courses PHY101 Physics, ACC502 Accounting, MATH201 Calculus; selected course PHY101; lecture rows 'Energy of motion' (Ready, 45:12, Sep 28), 'Newton's second law' (Ready, 52:08, Sep 25), 'Momentum and collisions' (Draft, 38:26, Sep 23), 'Work and power' (Ready, 41:35, Sep 21). Materials are 'Energy reference.pdf', 'Lecture slides.pdf', and 'Worked examples.md'. Readable example source excerpt: 'Kinetic energy depends on mass and speed. E_k = 1/2 mv^2.' Label the preview 'Demo library' unobtrusively. The product name is exactly 'LecNote'. Essential routes: Library, Courses, Materials, Search; Jobs and Settings may be quieter utility navigation. Header action 'Record lecture' is primary and an 'Add lecture' menu consolidates import actions. Search and filtering must be visible but not a wall of buttons. Do not invent users, collaborators, statistics, grades, upcoming schedule, streaks, AI chat, or cloud sync. Make source materials easily discoverable from the library. Make nav readable with familiar consistent lucide-like line icons and text labels. Use a white/light reading surface for daytime laptop study, strong contrast, fixed readable body type around 15-16px at this resolution, headings 26-34px, zero letter-spacing, radii <=8px, flat unframed sections, and fine rules. No oversized title, eyebrow/kicker label above headings, gradient, decorative blobs, dark teal sidebar, beige notebook texture, nested cards, exaggerated pill buttons, fake chart, or invented waveform. Individual document/file items may be genuinely framed. Show text-based source previews rather than fictional photos. Every control must look comfortably usable and every label fit. It should feel exceptionally finished, clear, and expressive through layout and precise details. Return only the screenshot image. DIRECTION: Course Editions, a student-authored publication translated into a usable study app, not a website selling zines. REUSABLE WORLD: one solar-yellow #f1de54 sheet color owns the navigation region and edge tabs; the main reading/index surface is near-white; ink #22221f, muted cherry #c8434b active record accents, mineral-blue #476e9b source indicators. Typography follows clean Letter Gothic-style typed labels, with a heavy condensed publication title kept to 32px; body stays readable, not distressed. Source inspiration: one continuous printed sheet, adjacent course territories visible as narrow color strips, one strong rule system, flat square checkbox cells and standard icon buttons. STRUCTURE: compact horizontal header with LecNote, Library/Courses/Materials/Search and record/add commands. A solar-yellow left course-tab area takes 190px, each tab clearly labels course code and name. A continuous near-white main sheet begins with 32px 'Physics' and a compact search/status row. A strong lecture index with four rows occupies left two-thirds; a materials tray on the right holds three text-source entries, fine rules, compact type badges, no fake artwork. The source tray should feel like part of the same sheet, not a separate floating card. This has more student-made personality and warm graphic energy while keeping clear familiar controls. Show clipped edges only on nonfunctional neighboring color strips; never cut off real text or controls. No ornamental grime, no torn-paper silhouette, no gigantic slogans, no marketing text.
